title: Fix Studio metadata form i18n coverage
body:
## Summary
- Generate metadata form field labels for every schema path so Studio forms have complete i18n keys
- Update i18n coverage expectations and extraction tests
- Regenerate metadata form bundles and add Studio Packages nav labels

## Verification
- pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli test -- i18n-coverage.test.ts i18n-extract.test.ts
- Previously verified platform-objects build/test and Studio browser flow during implementation
